description: Demolition of the existing building and erection of a part 8-storey, part 10-storey mixed-use building comprising light industrial and office commercial floorspace (Class E(g)) at ground and mezzanine levels, and Purpose-Built Shared Living (PBSL) studios on the upper floors, together with internal and external communal amenity space, ancillary coffee shop, basement cycle parking, plant equipment, car parking, and associated works (Sui Generis) (Amended)
